apps.name: Lara
apps.subtitle: DarkSword customization toolbox for iOS 17 - 26.0.1
apps.localizedDescription: lara is a jailed customization toolbox that uses the DarkSword exploit to reach the parts of the system iOS keeps locked: a full read/write file manager, a MobileGestalt editor, font / card / custom overwrites, status-bar tweaks, hidden icon labels, an upside-down mode, a five-icon dock, a grid app switcher, a performance HUD, DirtyZero 2, a three-app bypass and a JIT enabler for apps that carry get-task-allow. It is published as its own unsigned IPA for sideloading from the open-source repository.
apps.versionDescription:
lara 0.2 | lara_v0.2

## UX Changes
- Moved tweaks into its own accessible section, and put Tools there at the bottom.
- Moved logs out of the tab bar and into a toolbar item at the top of the primary views (you can change this back in settings).
- Settings has been completed reorganized, with some new customization toggles for the app itself.

## Applying/Handling
- Fixed kernelcache weirdness (kernelcache is now fetched locally)
- Hybrid will now be used by default.

## Tweaks
- Rewrote MobileGestalt View + Added a ton of tweaks! (thanks @jurre111)
- Rewrote Liquid Glass View with nice previewer.
- Fixed Passcode + Add repo viewer (thanks @neonmodder123)
- Add SpringBoard Customizer (thanks @leminlimez and Cowabunga, as well as @jurre111 for fixing the view)
- Add SystemColor patcher.

compatibility.notes: Firmware support as documented by upstream: iOS/iPadOS 17.0 - 18.7.1 and 26.0 - 26.0.1. iOS 16.x is technically affected by the exploit but has no offsets, and 18.7.2+ / 26.1+ are unsupported. Does not work on M5 or A19 (Pro) devices; on M-series CPUs upstream suggests setting t1sz_boot to 0x11 under Modify Offsets. Early-stage tool (0.x releases), so keep expectations modest.
